# Financial Times
> Global business, markets, economics and politics journalism, with market data, analysis, opinion and specialist newsletters.

The Financial Times publishes international reporting and commentary across finance, companies, policy, technology and geopolitics. Its site combines newsroom coverage, topic hubs, market data, newsletters, podcasts, video and subscription products.

## Top-Level News
- [Home](https://www.ft.com/): Front page with the latest FT reporting, analysis, opinion and curated coverage.
- [World](https://www.ft.com/world): International news and analysis across major regions, diplomacy and geopolitical developments.
- [US](https://www.ft.com/us): US politics, economy, business and policy coverage from FT correspondents.
- [Companies](https://www.ft.com/companies): Reporting on listed companies, sectors, deals, earnings and corporate strategy.
- [Opinion](https://www.ft.com/opinion): Columns, editorials and guest commentary on business, economics and politics.
- [Markets](https://www.ft.com/markets): News and analysis on equities, bonds, currencies, commodities and investors.
- [Technology](https://www.ft.com/technology): Coverage of big tech, startups, AI, semiconductors and digital policy.
- [Climate](https://www.ft.com/climate): Reporting on energy transition, climate policy, emissions and sustainable finance.

## World Regions
- [UK](https://www.ft.com/uk): UK politics, economy, regulation, companies and public policy coverage.
- [Europe](https://www.ft.com/europe): European Union, national politics, business and economic developments.
- [Asia Pacific](https://www.ft.com/asia-pacific): Regional news on China, Japan, India, ASEAN and cross-border business.
- [China](https://www.ft.com/china): China-focused reporting on economy, politics, trade, technology and markets.
- [Middle East & North Africa](https://www.ft.com/middle-east-north-africa): News and analysis on MENA politics, energy, finance and conflict.
- [Africa](https://www.ft.com/africa): Coverage of African economies, politics, investment and regional business.
- [Americas](https://www.ft.com/americas): News from North and South America on politics, trade and markets.
- [Emerging Markets](https://www.ft.com/emerging-markets): Reporting on developing economies, sovereign debt, currencies and investment.

## Markets & Investing
- [Markets News](https://www.ft.com/markets): FT journalism on market moves, central banks and investor strategy.
- [Markets Data](https://markets.ft.com/data): Live market data for equities, bonds, funds, currencies and commodities.
- [Equities](https://markets.ft.com/data/equities): Equity prices, indices, movers and company market performance data.
- [Funds](https://markets.ft.com/data/funds): Fund prices, performance, sectors and portfolio comparison tools.
- [Currencies](https://markets.ft.com/data/currencies): Exchange rates, currency pairs and foreign-exchange market data.
- [Commodities](https://markets.ft.com/data/commodities): Commodity prices and charts for energy, metals and agriculture.
- [Bonds](https://markets.ft.com/data/bonds): Government and corporate bond yields, prices and benchmark data.
- [ETF Hub](https://www.ft.com/etf-hub): ETF-focused reporting, analysis and data for exchange traded fund investors.

## Companies, Sectors & Industries
- [Companies](https://www.ft.com/companies): Corporate news, earnings, M&A, governance and sector reporting.
- [Financials](https://www.ft.com/financials): Banks, insurers, asset managers and financial services coverage.
- [Energy](https://www.ft.com/energy): Oil, gas, power, renewables and energy market reporting.
- [Industrials](https://www.ft.com/industrials): Manufacturing, transport, aerospace and industrial company coverage.
- [Media](https://www.ft.com/media): News on media groups, advertising, streaming and publishing.
- [Retail & Consumer](https://www.ft.com/retail-consumer): Reporting on retailers, brands, luxury and consumer trends.
- [Health](https://www.ft.com/health): Healthcare, pharmaceuticals, biotech and public health business coverage.
- [Tech Sector](https://www.ft.com/technology): Company and policy reporting across the technology industry.

## Economics, Policy & Society
- [Global Economy](https://www.ft.com/global-economy): Macroeconomics, inflation, trade, growth and central bank coverage.
- [UK Economy](https://www.ft.com/uk-economy): UK growth, inflation, fiscal policy and labour market reporting.
- [US Economy](https://www.ft.com/us-economy): US macroeconomic data, Federal Reserve policy and business conditions.
- [Trade](https://www.ft.com/trade): Global trade policy, tariffs, supply chains and international commerce.
- [Moral Money](https://www.ft.com/moral-money): Sustainability, ESG, climate finance and responsible business coverage.
- [Work & Careers](https://www.ft.com/work-careers): Management, workplace trends, leadership and career advice.
- [Life & Arts](https://www.ft.com/life-arts): Culture, lifestyle, books, travel, food and arts journalism.
- [HTSI](https://www.ft.com/htsi): How To Spend It luxury coverage on style, travel, watches and design.

## Opinion, Analysis & Editorial Products
- [Opinion](https://www.ft.com/opinion): FT columnists, editorials and expert guest commentary.
- [The Big Read](https://www.ft.com/big-read): Long-form explanatory features on major business and policy themes.
- [Editorial Board](https://www.ft.com/editorial-board): FT editorial positions on politics, economics and corporate issues.
- [Alphaville](https://www.ft.com/alphaville): FT’s markets and finance blog with commentary and analysis.
- [Lex](https://www.ft.com/lex): Concise analysis of companies, sectors and market developments.
- [FT View](https://www.ft.com/ft-view): Leader articles expressing the Financial Times editorial stance.

## Newsletters, Audio & Video
- [Newsletters](https://www.ft.com/newsletters): Directory of FT email newsletters across markets, policy and industries.
- [Podcasts](https://www.ft.com/podcasts): FT podcast hub for news briefings, interviews and specialist series.
- [Video](https://www.ft.com/video): Video reporting, interviews, explainers and documentary features.
- [FT News Briefing](https://www.ft.com/ft-news-briefing): Daily podcast summarising key global business and political stories.
- [Behind the Money](https://www.ft.com/behind-the-money): Podcast explaining major financial stories and market themes.
- [Working It](https://www.ft.com/working-it): Workplace and management podcast on careers and office culture.

## Products, Access & Subscriber Services
- [Subscribe](https://www.ft.com/products): FT digital subscription plans, trials and product options.
- [Gift Articles](https://www.ft.com/giftarticle): Share selected FT articles with non-subscribers through gift links.
- [myFT](https://www.ft.com/myft): Personalised feed for followed topics, saved articles and alerts.
- [Today's Newspaper](https://www.ft.com/todaysnewspaper): Digital replica and curated edition of the printed newspaper.
- [ePaper](https://www.ft.com/e-paper): Digital newspaper reading experience for subscribers.
- [FT Edit](https://www.ft.com/ft-edit): App-based selection of notable FT stories and commentary.
- [Group Subscriptions](https://enterprise.ft.com/en-gb/products/group-subscriptions/): Team and organisational access options for FT journalism.
- [Corporate Subscriptions](https://enterprise.ft.com/): Enterprise products, licensing and institutional access services.

## Help, Account & Policies
- [Help Centre](https://help.ft.com/): Support articles for subscriptions, billing, access and account management.
- [Contact Us](https://help.ft.com/contact-us/): Customer service and support contact options for FT users.
- [Manage Subscription](https://help.ft.com/help/account/how-can-i-manage-my-subscription-online/): Guidance for changing or administering an FT subscription.
- [Accessibility](https://help.ft.com/help/legal-privacy/accessibility-statement/): Accessibility statement and information on inclusive access to FT products.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://help.ft.com/help/legal-privacy/terms-conditions/): Legal terms governing use of FT services and subscriptions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://help.ft.com/help/legal-privacy/privacy-policy/): Information on data collection, cookies and privacy practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://help.ft.com/help/legal-privacy/cookies/): Details on FT cookie usage and consent choices.
